# Erdos.p41 — Erdős problem 41

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/41
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/41.lean`, theorem `erdos_41`, AMS 11).

Let `A ⊆ ℕ` be an infinite set such that the triple sums `a + b + c` are all distinct for
`a, b, c` in `A` (aside from the trivial coincidences). Is it true that
`liminf n → ∞ |A ∩ {1, …, N}| / N^(1/3) = 0`?

## Statement
∀ (A : Set ℕ) (h_triple : NtupleCondition A 3) (h_infinite : A.Infinite), Filter.atTop.liminf (fun N => (A ∩ Icc 1 N).ncard / (N : ℝ)^(1/3 : ℝ)) = 0

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
